name: monstera-native-generation
description: Validate a canonical spec, generate both native projects, verify ownership, build Android locally and confirm CI builds both platforms.

steps.prompt: Run `monstera validate {{spec}}`; stop and report the issues if it is invalid. Run `monstera generate {{spec}} --out {{out}} --check`. If it reports drift caused by the spec or templates (not by hand edits), run `monstera generate {{spec}} --out {{out}}`; if it refuses because of hand edits, stop and report them. Never use --force. Run `monstera verify {{out}}`. Write .kiro/workflow-output/native-generation/generate.json with {spec_sha256, files, verify}.

Build the generated Android project with the Device Lab build op: DL_APP_DIR={{out}}/android bash device-lab/android/adapter.sh build. Report the JSON result line and the Gradle outcome. Do not modify generated files.
Commit the regenerated output (if any) with a message naming the spec SHA-256 from {{artifacts.generate}}, and push the current branch. Never push to main.

Summarize the outcome using {{artifacts.generate}} and the CI result {{ci.output}} (it may be an idle-timeout). Write .kiro/workflow-output/native-generation/report.md with the verification label reached per platform and the evidence for each. Do not claim a level without evidence.
